name: repo-radar
description: A live GitHub dashboard for every repo across every account you're signed into. It installs an always-on-top desktop widget for you on first run.

open_widget.title: Open the widget with each session
open_widget.description: Opens the Repo Radar desktop widget when a session starts, and offers to install it the first time.

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional)
github_token.description: Used only when the gh CLI isn't signed in. A classic token with the repo and read:org scopes.
